decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for backpacks and noticed that many items were actually accessories or specialized gear (stoves, chairs, skate bags). Within the actual backpacks, durability was a recurring concern in the reviews for budget options (straps breaking on the Granite Gear and KAUKKO models). I narrowed my consideration to the most highly rated and reputable brands. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is an excellent budget choice for light use, and the Maxpedition models (038 and 096) are known for extreme durability. I chose the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic v2.0 (prod_backpacks_038) because it offers professional-grade build quality and a 4.7 rating in a discreet, everyday design, making it the most reliable long-term investment for a general-use backpack.
